cohort: The study included all singleton deliveries at Hadassah University Medical Center between 2003 and 2015, with a focus on preeclamptic patients and a control group of normotensive pregnant women matched for gestational age, gravidity, and parity.
finding: Hyponatremia was noted in 14.6% of preeclamptic patients and was strongly correlated with severe features of preeclampsia and adverse neonatal and obstetrical outcomes.
